cause_definitions.not_in_primary_candidates: Target absent from the matching primary stage-B input shortlist and response; says nothing about corpus/index coverage.
cause_definitions.not_in_primary_chunk_pool: Target was in the matching primary stage-B input shortlist but absent from its hit response; says nothing about corpus/index coverage.
cause_definitions.relevance_floor: Observed below-floor, non-exempt candidate absent from dedupe output.
cause_definitions.later_rank_or_cut: Target observed after dedupe but absent from complete final results.
cause_definitions.not_proven: Trace does not prove one of the listed causes.

truncation_note: A missing target is conclusive only when the relevant captured list is not truncated and the stage completed.
